fields.statement: At e5d6c9a2 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/daemon-(load-hold|status)': PASS. Read the diff: daemon-load-hold.txtar checks rhiza daemon status text and --json for the 1- and 5-minute load per core and available memory (idle, held, low-memory), the held state with reason load-high, a since time and detail, a still-held poll showing load-high, release to 'New runs held: no', and RHIZA_TEST_LOAD1/LOAD5/MEM_AVAILABLE=unavailable shown as 'unavailable on this platform' and "available": false with no hold. The daemon log (stderr) has exactly one 'holding new runs: load-high' line on the held poll, none on the still-held poll, and exactly one 'released the load-high hold' line on the released poll. The duplicate daemon-load-status.txtar is removed.
